boundary_notes: Right edge of the image shows fol. 85 beyond the gutter at about x≈3170, including marks such as ś/, ticks, shelfmarks, 'Cu Tatt...' and the bracketed note 'Tn. these three...'. These are excluded as facing-page material.
The arrow tail crosses the gutter, so its attachment between the pages is ambiguous.
b002 and b003 appear to be continuation material for entries on fol. 85, for example the Jalāśayotsarga entries. This parent attachment is not stated on this page.

annotations: Single line in ink, with no shelfmark or title on this page.

This is a single ink line at about y≈3000. The text matches, but r002 has two problems. 'fields.date' wrongly classes '1.0.1717' as a date: in context it is a collection reference, comparable to the 'I.O.1717' entries on fol. 85. The parenthetical reading is not marked as uncertain inside literal_text.
This is a single ink incipit line at about y≈3740. It is read correctly, and 'Begins' stays probable. It lies level with the 'ś/ √b. 95 (7)' row beyond the gutter. Its attachment remains uncertain.

Pencil 'ā/' at about x≈2995, y≈4040–4200, left of the gutter. The same mark also appears in the fol. 85 adjacent image, to the left of that image's gutter edge. So it is physically on fol. 84b and is not an offset. Its attachment stays uncertain.
Ink arrow pointing left, about x≈3009–3199, y≈3030. It lies level with b002 and with the d. 117 (5) row on fol. 85. The tail crosses the gutter slightly.

review.boundary_review: The facing page fol. 85 begins at the gutter, about x≈3166. The sigla, ticks, shelfmarks, 'Cu Tatt…' and the bracketed note 'Tn. these three…' beyond the gutter are all excluded. The arrow b901 and the mark b004 lie on the target side; the arrow tail crosses the gutter slightly. The attachments of b002, b003 and b004 to fol. 85 entries are not stated on this page and remain probable or uncertain.

region_review.top: Only the pencil '84b' is present. The ruled area above shows only faint show-through.
region_review.middle: There is no writing apart from faint offset or show-through, which is not transcribed.
region_review.bottom: The incipit line b003 and the pencil ā/ b004 are present. Below them, down to the page edge, only show-through is visible.
region_review.right_margin: The ā/ mark and the arrow are near the gutter. Material beyond the gutter belongs to fol. 85.
region_review.interlinear: There is no interlinear addition. There is one overwritten word in b002.
